target_customer: Black viewers in the US paying a monthly subscription for original Black content
problem: Mainstream streamers underserve Black audiences and creators; BlackOak aimed to fund and distribute original series for them.
business_model: Consumer subscription video on demand (beta priced $4.99 per month)

founders.name: Uzo Ometu
prior_employers: Google (7 years with YouTube, content partnerships team)
founders.background_notes: Per Tubefilter February 2021. YC bio cites journalism, entertainment and technology experience.

founders.name: Iyanu Obidele
founders.background_notes: Per the YC page: product generalist who built cloud orchestration systems.

technical_complexity.rationale: Video streaming can use off-the-shelf delivery stacks; the hard part was commissioning content.

defensibility.rationale: Original content and a community brand could differentiate, but there were no network effects and large streamers could license similar content.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent acting against BlackOakTV directly; the 2025 post by the founder describes it as a past experience.

market_need_then: Tubefilter in February 2021 quoted the founder citing a claim that 75 percent of Black people want more content targeting them, and said other services existed for Black viewers without naming them.

branding.name_origin: Per Tubefilter, 'oak' evokes the strength of the Black community and OAK is an acronym for ownership, ability and knowledge.
branding.brand_signature: Tagline 'Still we stream', launched at the start of Black History Month 2021
branding.community_and_virality: Covered by Tubefilter, Black N LA and Urban Geekz in 2021.

brand_strength.rationale: Meaningful name with a clear acronym and tagline, and press at launch, but no evidence of a large audience.

outcome_analysis: BlackOakTV launched a beta subscription in February 2021 with original series and backing from Backstage Capital and The W Fund, then joined YC in Summer 2021. The YC directory marks it inactive and a dead-startups archive says no follow-on round was raised, but no founder post-mortem was found, so the cause is not public.
notes: Funding sources conflict. The September 2021 Seed II of about $130K rests on CB Insights alone (total about $250K over 3 rounds). Caplight reports a seed of 2021-10-07 with about $1.63M total and Employbl shows two $1.5M seeds; neither is corroborated and neither is recorded. The February 2021 round amount was undisclosed. blackoak.tv did not resolve in this session. Competitors left empty: Tubefilter says rivals existed but names none, and Kweli TV and Brown Sugar appear only in later roundups.
